anchor.statement: Corollary B.6. There is t c > 0, with t c < t 1 and 4e t c < 4.1, such that the functions E/ √ 2X, U, V 0 /X, Π on [0, X 0 e t c] × [−1, 1] are smooth in (X, η ) through X = 0 and analytic in η on one complex neighborhood. Every fixed radial derivative of these four functions has that same parameter neighborhood and finite bounds on a smaller neighborhood. On X 0 < X ≤ X 0 e t c, the admissible stress cone condition and the factorization (B.30) hold. All subsequent profile modifications are supported strictly to the right of X 0 e t c.

correspondence.by: Christian Garry (drafted with Claude Code; second review by ChatGPT, checked)
correspondence.note: By composition: the tube fields f, U, Ubar, Π are regular with every fixed radial jet on one complex domain and equal the real activation histories; f, U and the pressure of the nominal profile equal the activation fields on the analytic collar; the forward histories agree below; V0/X is the quotient formula of radialFlux_div_radial; and window_order orders zeroEnd < cutoffInner < cutoffStop before later modifications. Not stated in the cited declarations: tc < t1 and 4e^(tc) < 4.1, and the admissible stress cone condition with the factorization (B.30) on X0 < X ≤ X0 e^(tc); the reviewer also mentions nominal_ACT_fields without listing it.
